questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
No — FA-2026-0217 should not be paid as it stands.

The invoice matches order BC-2026-012 in the Moreau purchasing follow-up: Zava Matériaux, delivered 13/03/2026, invoice FA-2026-0217, invoiced HT 1,484.80 €. The invoice also states the required order, delivery note and site, and payment terms/due date are consistent with the framework agreement.

However, one line is over the contract price: ZM-20450 “Bloc béton creux 20 x 20 x 50 cm” is invoiced at 79.20 € HT per pallet, while the 2026 framework tariff sets the net contract price at 76.80 € HT. For 10 pallets, the overcharge is 24.00 € HT, i.e. 28.80 € TTC. Under the framework agreement, any line invoiced above the annexed net tariff must give rise to a credit note for the difference.

Corrected amount would be: 1,460.80 € HT, VAT 292.16 €, total 1,752.96 € TTC. Also, the site minutes record an action to verify this invoice against the 13/03/2026 delivery note before payment; the signed delivery note itself is not in the retrieved documents.

Preparation pack — Moreau site meeting no. 4

Meeting details: site meeting no. 4 is scheduled for 07/04/2026 at 08:30 on the Moreau site, 12 chemin des Vergers, Valbrise. It follows site meeting no. 3 of 24/03/2026. The previous minutes were drafted by Inès Roux, Lamna Bâtiment conductrice de travaux.

Agenda for meeting no. 4:
1. Progress review: confirm masonry wall elevation status after the 70% progress reported on 24/03/2026; confirm start/status of timber frame and roofing planned from 30/03/2026, including the roof window from amendment no. 1 signed on 10/03/2026.
2. Activities starting on 07/04/2026: confirm electrical works for the extension from 07/04 to 10/04; confirm kitchen renovation brought forward, with removal and plumbing from 07/04 to 10/04; confirm provisional timber-board closure of openings on 07/04 so that insulation can start from 13/04.
3. External joinery risk: review VanArsdel’s reported postponement of joinery delivery for order BC-2026-009 from 30/03 to 20/04, with installation planned 21/04–23/04.
4. Wall opening and reception: confirm that the existing wall opening remains postponed until after joinery installation, planned 27/04–29/04, and that handover remains scheduled for 15/05/2026.
5. Open actions from meeting no. 3 to close: planning update PLN-2026-003 indice B by Inès Roux due 27/03; verification of Zava Matériaux invoice FA-2026-0217 against delivery note of 13/03 before payment by Bertrand Sauzède due 31/03; confirmation of electrical intervention by Damien Pradère due 31/03; kitchen cupboards to be emptied by the Moreau family due 03/04.
6. Commercial / scope reminders: the current quote is DEV-2026-014 indice B, dated 03/02/2026, which cancels and replaces indice A; it covers the 30 m² single-storey extension and kitchen renovation, including the 3.00 m aluminium sliding bay F1, two PVC windows F2/F3, electrical works for the extension, and kitchen works. Note also the client’s 04/03 request to add a roof window plus an exterior socket and detector light; meeting no. 3 states the roof window is included in amendment no. 1 signed on 10/03/2026, but the provided documents do not show the price or signed content of that amendment.
